card.text: K dwarf in Vulpecula that hosts the hot Jupiter HD 189733b.

introduction.text: HD 189733 A is an orange dwarf 20 parsecs away. It spins in 11.5 days on an axis tilted about 14° from its giant planet's orbit.

color.title: Photosphere colour
color.summary: The colour of Gaia's spectrum of the star, darker toward the edge as its planet's transits show. No surface picture exists.
